GopherLLM real-model WebGPU benchmark

Loads the real Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512-Q4_K_M.gguf (~2GB) via /models/ and measures actual generation throughput with WebGPU acceleration enabled (the default). This is the first real attempt at the full-size model in a browser tab -- both "does it fit in wasm32's address space" and "what's the real tok/s" are open questions until now.
